recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: AISA Chief Neha Bora Defies Delhi Police Peace Bond After High Court Setback, Says ‘Will Not…’ WATCH
recentItems.description:
AISA Chief Neha Bora Defies Delhi Police Peace Bond After High Court Setback, Says ‘Will Not…’ WATCH

AISA president Neha Bora has refused to sign a ₹10,000 peace bond sought by Delhi Police after the Delhi High Court dismissed her challenge to the notice. Bora says she will continue contesting the move, arguing it threatens peaceful dissent. The court directed authorities to share the material supporting the proceedings.

recentItems.description:

Meanwhile, Iranian security officials told Reuters that Tehran has drawn up plans to target undersea communication cables in the Gulf if the US and Israel resume their military campaign. Iran has also warned of retaliation against critical infrastructure, including internet cables and US-linked technology facilities. The threats have raised concerns about possible disruptions to internet connectivity, financial transactions and cloud computing across the region.
